purpose: Controlled equal-rate official-packet sampling study; not natural 5G deployment performance
tuning: No hyperparameter selection using primary evaluation results
replication: Frozen traffic common to every N/trial; seeds control model only; OVS sampling randomness is uncontrolled and recorded
provenance: Official release checksums, exact flow-family match, disjoint original capture packet indices within and across scenarios, mappings retain original and rewritten hashes; naturally duplicate payloads are possible
eligibility: Only independently observed fully covered windows; gaps, transitions, capture failures and unknown/drain windows are not benign zeros
minimum_support: Report actual evaluated benign/attack windows for each run; undefined metrics stay unavailable; no minimum F1 is a completion or exclusion rule

baseline.purpose: Known benign/UDP/SYN distribution from warm-up with later disjoint selections

drift.purpose: Controlled attack-family covariate shift from UDP to ICMP after block7; not naturally occurring concept drift

unseen.purpose: SYN excluded from the entire initial learning segment and first introduced during evaluation
